scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @solidloom/server && npm run build -w @solidloom/cli && npm run build -w @solidloom/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @solidloom/shared && npm run build -w @solidloom/cad-engine
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @solidloom/server" "npm run dev -w @solidloom/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @solidloom/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @solidloom/web
scripts.cli: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @solidloom/cli --
